Rachel / team — below is language Legal has approved for customer-facing commitments. This is intentionally precise to avoid ambiguity. Also attached the internal SLA delete playbook and a one-page Data Use Pledge we can DocuSign.

--- Suggested customer-facing clause (approved) ---
"Redwood Inference will not use Customer Content to train or improve our foundation models or model derivatives. Customer Content will not be incorporated into model training datasets, fine-tuning, or other machine learning pipelines. This commitment applies to Redwood and its subprocessors for Hosted and Dedicated deployments. For Private (customer-managed) deployments, Redwood does not have access to customer content and therefore does not use it for training.

Operational retention notes: Redwood retains ephemeral request caches and operational telemetry for service quality and abuse detection only. Ephemeral caches are retained for up to 7 days and telemetry (non-content metadata) for up to 90 days by default. Persistent backups and database snapshots are retained per the customer's selected retention tier; for Hosted customers without a dedicated retention tier, backups are retained for up to 30 days and are immutable for disaster recovery. On a verified deletion request, Redwood will delete Customer Content from live stores within 72 hours and will begin deletion from backups/snapshots within 30 days, subject to restoration windows and cloud-provider snapshot immutability.

Exceptions: data subject to legal hold, regulatory obligations, or security investigations will be retained as required by law."
--- end clause ---

Operational note: we should offer FinSecure the Dedicated or Private option if they need tighter retention/zero-access guarantees; Dedicated can enforce a shorter backup window and Private is fully customer-controlled.

I attached: redwood-no-training-commitment-2026.docx (customer pledge), SLA-delete-playbook.pdf (ops procedures). Recommend sending the pledge as a DocuSign link and offering a 30‑minute call to walk through the playbook.

Neha
Neha Kapoor
